view: Frontal (PA-type) chest radiograph; "L" side marker at the image's upper right confirms conventional orientation (patient's left on image right)
technical_quality: Adequate inspiration with roughly 9-10 posterior ribs visible; no significant rotation (clavicular heads roughly equidistant from the spinous processes); scapulae projected laterally, largely clear of the lung fields. Penetration is limited in the lower half of the film - the lower zones, both hemidiaphragms and costophrenic angles are partly obscured by dense overlying soft tissue (breast shadows / body habitus), so the lung bases and pleural recesses are incompletely assessable. Upper and middle zones are well exposed. Costophrenic angles and apices included.

devices.type: external side marker (letter L with adjacent mirrored/rotated lettering)
devices.location: upper right corner of the image, over the patient's left shoulder soft tissue - external, not on the patient

abnormalities.finding: Increased lucency with attenuated/pruned peripheral vascular markings in both upper zones, pattern consistent with emphysematous change
Mild hyperinflation - tall lung fields with a narrow, elongated cardiac silhouette
Prominent bilateral hilar / central pulmonary vessels with relatively coarse central bronchovascular markings
Both lower zones, hemidiaphragms and costophrenic angles obscured by dense overlying soft tissue (breast / body habitus); no definite effusion or consolidation identified but assessment is limited
A few tiny dense dots in both hilar regions - most likely end-on vessels or small calcified nodes (low confidence)

description_zh: 正面胸部X光，L標記位於影像右側，吸氣深度尚可、無明顯旋轉，但下半部影像因胸壁及乳房軟組織重疊而穿透度不足，雙側下肺野、橫膈與肋膈角評估受限。雙側上肺野透亮度增加、周邊血管紋理稀疏，肺容積偏大、心影狹長，雙側肺門血管略顯粗大，整體符合肺氣腫型變化。心臟大小正常，氣管與縱膈居中，未見氣胸、明確實質病灶或肋膈角鈍化；骨骼未見明顯骨折或破壞性病灶。未見任何導管、引流管、手術夾或植入裝置。
